nodes.description: Boolean flag controlling whether the game (reward/burn logic) is active.
Address of the Uniswap liquidity pool used to detect game-triggering transfers.
Mutable nonce mixed into the pseudo-random keccak256 calculation.
First seed set by the owner in startGame and used by _play/_randModulus.
Second seed derived from _randModulus(10000000, seed1) in startGame.
Win chance rate hard-coded to 100 during startGame.
Constructor minting 2500e18 tokens to msg.sender and initializing gameStarted=false.
onlyOwner function that configures liquidityPool, seed1/seed2, chanceRate and starts the game.
Overridden ERC20 transfer that funnels the amount through _getAmount.
Overridden ERC20 transferFrom that funnels the amount through _getAmount.
View function returning the gameStarted flag.
Private hook that triggers reward minting and random burning when the game is started.
Private reward logic: mints amount*10 to recipient when sender is the liquidity pool and _play() wins.
Private function computing the pseudo-random burn amount (1%-10% of amount).
Public game function comparing two random values for a 1% win chance.
Private weak pseudo-random generator based on nonce, seed, now, block.difficulty and msg.sender.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, sender identity and randomness seed.
Block timestamp (now) mixed into the pseudo-random number generation.
Unsafe _mint(recipient, amount.mul(10)) that can arbitrarily inflate supply.
Unsafe _burn(sender, burnAmount) destroying user tokens based on weak randomness.
keccak256 over nonce/seed/now/block.difficulty/msg.sender: predictable on-chain randomness.
Multiplication amount.mul(10) used for the reward mint.
Division amount.div(burnrate.add(10)) computing the burn amount.
Unchecked nonce++ state mutation inside the random generator.

edges.reason: transfer computes the effective amount via _getAmount before calling super.transfer.
transferFrom computes the effective amount via _getAmount before calling super.transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed as the sender argument into _getAmount from transfer.
_getAmount calls _sendReward when gameStarted is true.
_getAmount requests a random burn amount from _getRandomBurnedAmount.
_getAmount triggers _burn(sender, burnAmount) on the transferred amount.
Return value of _getRandomBurnedAmount is stored in the burnAmount local variable.
burnAmount local variable flows into the _burn call.
Burn amount is computed with amount.div(burnrate.add(10)) inside _getRandomBurnedAmount.
Random burn rate is assigned to the burnrate local variable.
burnrate local variable is used as the divisor in the burn amount computation.
_sendReward calls _play() to decide whether the reward is granted.
_sendReward performs _mint(recipient, amount.mul(10)) when the sender is the liquidity pool and the game is won.
Reward mint uses amount.mul(10), an unchecked high-magnitude multiplication.
_play obtains its two random values from _randModulus.
_randModulus hashes nonce, seed, now, block.difficulty and msg.sender as a weak randomness source.
block.timestamp (now) is mixed into the keccak256 randomness, creating timestamp dependency.
msg.sender is used as an input to the randomness hash.
The keccak256 randomness result is reduced modulo mod and stored in the rand local variable.
_randModulus reads and increments the nonce state variable.
_randModulus performs the unchecked nonce++ mutation.
_randModulus consumes the seed1 state variable as its seed input.
_randModulus consumes the seed2 state variable as its seed input.
_play uses seed1 for its first random draw.
_play uses seed2 for its second random draw.
startGame writes the owner-supplied seed into seed1.
startGame writes the derived value into seed2.
startGame sets chanceRate to 100.
startGame stores the liquidity pool address.
startGame flips gameStarted to true.
startGame calls _randModulus to derive seed2.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with the stored owner before allowing startGame.
_getAmount reads the gameStarted flag to decide whether to run reward/burn logic.
_sendReward compares the sender against the stored liquidityPool address.
The constructor mints the initial supply to msg.sender.
The constructor invokes the ERC20 minting logic for the initial 2500e18 supply.

The _liquidityPool parameter of startGame flows into the liquidityPool state variable.
